Hey, our engineering team just finished building the Kanban board feature — it has three layered data models: BoardViewModel (with a title and description), ColumnViewModel (with a column name, containing cards), and CardViewModel (which has a card title and a dynamic due-date label that fills in the number of days at runtime). We need full test coverage for all three of these before the next sprint review.

A few important requirements from the product side:
- We're launching in English, Spanish, AND British English markets simultaneously, so all three language variants must be covered.
- The due-date label on cards is dynamic (it says something like 'Due in 3 days'), so the test needs to verify that substitution actually works for English.
- The test file should be named `KanbanBoardViewModelTests.swift`.
- The YAML translation file(s) should live alongside our other test translation files.

Please generate both the Swift test suite and the required YAML translation file(s). Look at the existing `UserViewModelTests.swift` in the project for structural guidance on where things should go.
